exchanges.purpose: Align the same fictional case across prototypes; add immediate seeded recipient sample and two review checks; preserve handed-off approved information during revisions.
exchanges.result: Updated B.html only. The recipient view shows four cards and the exact approved report with TXT export. The shared case is Alex Morgan, RF-1042, with the specified source facts. Open approved sample creates explicitly labelled fictional seeded approval and handoff without marking the user's checks complete. Clinician review and recipient confirmation are separately required for every user approval. Edits and revisions invalidate current approval but retain the previously handed-off snapshot and its version-bound local response; a newer approval replaces it only after explicit simulated handoff. Follow-up timing and the legacy specialistNext field are synchronized. Added navy/blue branding, evidence link, keyboard tabs, mobile overrides, reset, local response export, and current-versus-recipient version notices. Passed 53 targeted Node VM API/markup assertions. No browser, server, publication, or live sending was performed. Original logs/B.json was not modified.
